sources.name: JMdict — James William Breen / Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group
sources.usage: Vocabulary verification, corrected spellings/readings/glosses and part-of-speech metadata via OpenJLPT; romanized here. No imported Tatoeba examples.

sources.name: KANJIDIC2 — James William Breen / EDRDG
sources.usage: Kanji stroke counts, Japanese readings and English meanings via OpenJLPT. Levels are community estimates, not official JLPT assignments.

sources.name: OpenJLPT — Evan Clan and contributors
sources.usage: Verified vocabulary and kanji JSON, revision 0d1d3410bec90bd4098a7c72de820543cb4f707c; fields mapped to this app, vocabulary romanized and categorized. Upstream NOTICE and LICENSE included locally.

sources.name: Jonathan Waller's JLPT Resources
sources.license: CC BY (as recorded in OpenJLPT NOTICE)
sources.usage: Community-estimated N5–N1 level lists and vocabulary glosses through OpenJLPT. Attribution/license documented in its pinned NOTICE.md; original host DNS was unavailable at verification time. No claim of official exam coverage.

sources.name: KanjiVG — Ulrich Apel and contributors
sources.usage: Unmodified SVGs, revision 610091ce618cf757ed1357a8954cd65283e015d6; 2548 single-character stroke diagrams. Missing codepoints: none. Multi-kana combinations are written as their separate component characters.

sources.name: Original Japanese curriculum
sources.usage: Original grammar explanations, examples, exercises, kana tables and estimated study sequence; not endorsed by JLPT or dictionary authors.

sources.name: Tae Kim's Guide to Learning Japanese (reference only)
sources.license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 US (official grammar guide web page)
sources.usage: Local PDF reference at grammar_guide.pdf, copied unmodified for noncommercial study. The 353-page PDF has no discoverable license notice; the official corresponding grammar-guide page explicitly supplies this license. Not the source of the authored lessons; not claimed to cover every N1 topic.

levelAssignment: ESTIMATED: no official exhaustive JLPT vocabulary/kanji syllabus exists. Vocabulary and kanji use Jonathan Waller's community level assignments, corrected and deduplicated by OpenJLPT. Grammar levels are independently authored estimates. None is an official exam guarantee.
